description:
What this is. Plan who goes for the annual medical tests and when. Pick the test package and the dates, then the departments and designations that are due.

Get Employees fills the list from those filters (optionally a few at random from each designation). Create Test Requests then raises a Clinic Test Request for each one and sends it to Cova.
name: Schedule Annual Medical Tests
title: Annual Test Schedule — plan the year's tests
